newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Sept 6.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Government considers reforming the electoral process for members of parliament to introduce proportional representation.
-- Thomson SA subsidiary Thomson Multimedia showed 3 billion francs loss in the first half.
-- Italian insurer Generali to sell its 10.8 percent stake in Axa back to the French insurer.
-- Scor re-insurance firm posts a 40 percent rise in profits for the first half.
-- British food group Grand Metropolitan to sell 11 European subsidiaries, including French pastry manufacturer Brossard.
